page.overview:
What is Hand Claws?

In Mortal Kombat: Legacy, Cyrax, after being turned into a Cyborg Ninja and sent to fight Hydro, would use hidden hand claws with forked blades to finish off Hydro with a Fatality by beheading him with said claws. These claws appear to replace his well-known Sawblades.
